name: Imperial Outriders

specialRules.name: Mounted warband
specialRules.text: Every model comes with a Riding Horse (upgradable to a Warhorse for +40 gc). Mounted warriors may not fight with two weapons (a shield or buckler may be used as normal; two-handed weapons not permitted; a pistol in the first round of combat replaces the usual weapon). Enemies may not target a ridden horse, only the rider; any mounted warrior may always be chosen as a shooting target even if enemies are closer, with no +1 to hit.

specialRules.name: Dense terrain
specialRules.text: May ignore the normal warband limitation of two mounts in areas of dense terrain.

specialRules.name: Dead mounts
specialRules.text: Dead horses must be replaced before any other income is spent; a model without a mount may not take part in the battle. A rider whose mount survives may be replaced on it, reducing its cost by 40 gc.

specialRules.name: Hired Swords
specialRules.text: May only be accompanied by mounted Hired Swords.

conversionNotes: No d6 thresholds appear in the warband rules, so no dice conversions were applied (the Whoa Boy! table and Blazing Saddles skills are external references).

Equipment is split into three lists: hand-to-hand weapons plus armour (shared), Outrider Missile weapons, Scout Missile weapons. Knight and Hussars take only the main list. Outriders and Chasseurs also take Outrider Missile; Scouts and Grooms also take Scout Missile.
Grooms' printed text says they may take missile weapons 'from the Imperial Outriders' Equipment List' and also 'from the Scouts' Missile Weapon List'; implemented as Scout Missile only, check.
Mounts: every fighter comes with a Riding Horse (cost included); Warhorse upgrade +40 gc listed as a misc item. Barding is printed in the armour section at 80 gc and kept as armour.
Skill table has a 'Cavalry' column (Blazing Saddles skills) in place of Special. Knight: all six; Outrider: Combat, Shooting, Strength, Cavalry; Scout: Combat, Shooting, Speed, Cavalry.
Max 12 warriors. Knight 1; Outriders 0-2; Scouts 0-2; Chasseurs 0-5; Hussars 0-5; Grooms 0-2.
